content: Gotomwa Yoho Paganina Iya Yehoba wana Bateli ana Etotohi
Abalam wana baliman 99 yaka Yehoba i masal elana ge i baek elana i ba, “Nau Yabowaine Togasisi Hot. U mipalalem eliyau ge bahi wam ginol nanakina ni gagan.
He no bateli na ginol eliyam tubutubumwau na pagewel.”
Yaka Abalam i kululu maninina i patupa bilibiliya, inoke Yabowaine i baek elana i ba,
“He nau no bateli toto ya ginol eliyam i ola hiwe: nasi nu tabwa boda nihi gewi tubuliya.
Alam nige al ni oola te Abalam, yaa alam na tun Abalahama,
kaiwena iyaka ya ba nu tabwa boda nihi gewi tubuliya.
Tubutubumwau na pagewel yaka nihi tabwa boda nihi gewi, ge kin ona nihi masalem owa eliyam.
Bateli toto ya ginol iya bateli mihomihotina owa eliyam ge tubutubumwau emwa heyan ge heyan elal. Ya bateli nau wam Yabowaine ge tubutubumwau wali Yabowaine.
Labi Kenani sauga ya eliyana u mibwabwali, bwalibwaligena na pewa ni mihot eliyam ge tubutubumwau eliyalil, yaka nau na ola wali Yabowaine.”
Yaka Yabowaine i ba vevehe al Abalahama elana i ba, “He owa no bateli ana logugui nu henapuan, owa ge tubutubumwau emwa heyan ge heyan.
He no bateli toto ya ginol owa eliyam ge tubutubumwau eliyalil ana logugui i ola hiwe: wami bolau gegewel gotomwa yoho paganina nihi ahe.
Tuwamiu buhuna kunisina nuku gotomwa yoho ge ni tabwa bateli toto ya ginol eliyamiu ana etotohi.

Wami bolau heyan ge heyan, sauga nihi abil ge wali lan eit ni mowasi, yaka gotomwa yoho paganina nihi ahe. Gegewel nihi ahe: komiu natumiyau, wami totuwalali loloyowanil bolo hi abil wami limi ana heniheni gamwaliyaa, ge i ola al wami totuwalali loloyowanil bolo ku pwamolal hi neem labi getoga.
Gegewel gotomwa yoho paganina nihi ahe inoke no bateli mihomihotina ana etotohi ni minaa tuwamiwa.
Ebo melutau etega nige tuwana buhuna kunisina nihi gogotomwa yoho, he ni mitagil wana boda gamagaliliyau gamwaliyaa, kaiwena no bateli ana logugui i leke.”
Yaka Yabowaine i ba vevehe al Abalahama elana i ba, “He lagom Selai, nige al alana ni oola te Selai, yaa alana nu tun Sela.
Na muloluan yaka natum melutauina ni ab. Na muloluan ni tabwa boda nihi gewi tubuliya, ge panuwa ona wali kin nihi masalem iya eliyana.”

Yaka Abalahama i kululu maninina i patupa bilibiliya. Yaa Yehoba wana baaba nige i memelteli-an, yaka i nival ge atena elana i ba, “No baliman iyaka elulu bwagabwaga (100), he ga na ola ge natu ni gan? Ge Sela iyaka wana baliman 90, he ga ni ola ge ni ab?”
Yaka Abalahama i baek Yabowaine elana i ba, “Binimala Isimel te ni tabwa wam ba mulolu gamagalina, yaka toto u bateli eliyau nu ginola iya eliyana.”
Inoke Yabowaine i ba, “Nigeya! Lagom Sela natum melutauina ni ab yaka alana nu tun Aisake.
No bateli na ginola iya eliyana, bateli mihomihotina tubutubunau enaa heyan ge heyan kaiweliya.

He wam awanun Isimel kaiwena iyaka ya hago: tunahot na muloluan, yaka tubutubunau na pagewel. Bwaliga natunau melubolau ali gewi elulutega eluwa heliya nihi tabwa un ali tohouwa, ge tubutubunau nihi gewi na pek nihi tabwa boda gasigasisena etega.
Yaa no bateli na ginola Aisake eliyana, iya baliman i nenem gamwanaa, ni ola te sauga e, Sela ni ab.”
He Yabowaine wana baaba i pwamowasi, yaka i eguluwai.

Inoke lan o elana Abalahama i ginol i ola Yabowaine wana baaba ge bolau gegewel wana limi ana heniheni elana tuwaliya buhuna kunisina i gotomwa yoho: natuna Isimel, wana totuwalali loloyowanil bolo hi abil wana limi ana heniheni gamwaliyaa, ge wana totuwalali loloyowanil bolo i pwamolal hi neem labi getoga.
He Abalahama wana baliman 99 te tuwana buhuna kunisina hi gotomwa yoho,
ge natuna Isimel wana baliman elulutega eton (13).
He liwanina i ola to, inoke lan toto Yabowaine i baaba Abalahama elana, Abalahama alona natuna Isimel gotomwa yoho paganina hi ahe.
I ola al, lan o elana bolau gegewel wana limi ana heniheni elana gotomwa yoho paganina hi ahe.

footnotes.text: Pana Hibilu elana alan “Abalahama” ana hago i ola “hi gewi tubuliya.”
Pana Hibilu elana alan “Aisake” ana sapu te “i nival.”
